owner.current_role: Senior Architect – Global Services at Red Hat

technology: Technology must empower people and deliver real value to end users.
Architecture is a means to enable teams and organizations, not an end in itself.
Continuous improvement is more realistic and honest than the idea of 'transformation'.
leadership: Focus on growing people and teams so systems and applications can evolve sustainably.
Promote autonomy, mastery, and collaboration in engineering teams.
Balance strategic thinking with hands-on support and mentoring.

domains: Community leadership, mentoring, and developer advocacy
AI-assisted software development and early technology adoption
Cloud Native Architecture and Platform Engineering
DevOps, GitOps, and Internal Developer Platforms (IDP)
highlights: Delivered production-ready MVPs in 2 weeks using AI copilots and cloud-native stacks.
Led modernization and platform initiatives for enterprise and financial services clients.
Consistently achieved NPS 9–10 in delivery engagements.
Organized and contributed to DevOpsDays Santiago and Open Source Santiago.

traits: Pragmatic about quality: reliable and sustainable, never at the expense of creativity
Solitary; depends on others yet often feels alone
communication: Avoids absolutist statements; prefers to narrate context and let others think freely.
Focuses on facts, impact, and learning rather than ego or blame.
decision_criteria: Prefer new, unresolved problems over well-defined, stable ones.
When a role or project becomes predictable, seek new scope or a new challenge.
Treat established procedures as a baseline to question, not a script to follow.
Aim for reliable and sustainable quality; reject quality gates that block creation.
Create or reinvent when it opens a new possibility; reuse when it frees time to create elsewhere.
Compete mainly to measure myself against the best; winning ranks last as an end in itself.
Do not avoid a problem because of its difficulty or adversity.
Work autonomously on the core idea and rely on others for scale and execution.
red_lines: Never stop being who I am.
Never give weight to the opinions of people I do not know or do not respect or admire.

usage_guidelines_for_llm.primary_language: Spanish for interaction, English for technical content and CVs when needed.
priorities: Align answers with Sergio's real experience and principles.
Prefer human-centered, sustainable solutions over purely technical cleverness.
Emphasize continuous improvement instead of 'big bang transformations'.
usage_guidelines_for_llm.decision_replication: To predict a decision, follow AGENTS.md: use real cases in decisions/, apply the priorities and red lines in philosophy/personality-and-decision-criteria.md, and state confidence and open gaps.
